entry.name: busabase
entry.description: Shared records, docs and skills for teams and AI agents, with permission-aware changes.

requiredBeforeSubmission: Pin sha to the full 40-character commit that was actually validated; do not use a mutable branch.
Run current hermes plugins validate <pinned-checkout> --install-deps; record native load and the minimum supported Hermes version.
Resolve catalog plugin.yaml prerequisite versus documented portable plugin.json support.
Verify OAuth: portable transport translation supplies URL but not native auth: oauth; use the documented explicit native configuration if required.
Verify capability declarations against current validation and disclose any remote-MCP behavior.
Raise a reviewed SHA-bump PR for future catalog updates; do not add self-updating plugin code.
